title: Python: node TX RX and forwarding integration
description:
Integrate python.03-.12 through python/src/lichen/node.py and python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py for locally originated packets, relayed Announce, forwarding, retries, baseline SCHC fragments and control responses. Every production emission must use receiver-aware scheduling, complete-operation admission and legal/adaptive accounting. Preserve bounded queues, deadlines, priorities, explicit back-pressure and existing custody storage/expiry policy.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.

Decomposition review scope: Explicitly own or verify and reuse bounded coalescing of pending, explicitly replaceable position/status updates in the Python node/application enqueue path. Keep the latest value only for the same intended resource/recipient/context; do not merge distinct messages, commands, receipts, historical samples or custody records. Prefer coalescing before protection and sequence allocation; preserve existing OSCORE interfaces and never reuse a nonce or reinterpret ciphertext.
design: This completes the relevant project-LICHEN-6acc integration scope, not a replacement stack. Reuse f0vn/fw0f/hxqj fixes and existing queue/security interfaces. vectors.12 is the separately owned Python production-consumer leaf; do not depend on it here because it depends on python.01-.12. Existing 7wpz C CoAP response work is outside this scope. Keep key portability deferred and audited OSCORE/EDHOC internals human-only.
acceptance_criteria:
Exercise frozen wire, calendar, queue and ledger cases through actual Node TX/RX and radio-call boundaries. Test urgent traffic arriving during committed RX, loss of sync during await, complete-fragment charges, expired queues and no bypass by control/SOS/forwarding. Assert upstream Yggdrasil addresses and radio-owned identity are preserved. Extend python/tests/test_node.py and python/tests/link/test_link_layer.py, then run applicable Node integration tests, scoped pytest/ruff and existing configured typing gates. No zero-case or helper-only completion.

Additional required acceptance: Production positive coalescing cases from vectors.08 and ci.09 have an identified implementation entry point or verified reusable path. Negative cases preserve nonreplaceable records and recipient/security-context separation; no new congestion controller or audited OSCORE semantic change.
notes: Task-definition amendment after independent decomposition review. This commissions future work only; nothing was implemented or tested. The initial CLI-input fingerprint is retained as initial_scope_sha256; current native Beads fields are authoritative. Do not rerun the seed applicator over this reviewed amendment.
